text:
deploy-bot: Starting staged rollout: service=api-gateway image=redwood/api:2.7.3 -> releasing 5% traffic to us-west (change window 03:00-04:00 UTC). Release notes: https://redwood.dev/rn/2.7.3 :rocket:

amanda: quick note — added a tiny changelog fix a few mins ago, it's just docs in release notes (typo). CI green.

javier: re: canary signals — alert thresholds set: 5xx > 0.5% OR p99 latency increase > 150ms will trigger auto-hold. Also KV cache eviction rate monitored.

leo: @javier can you confirm rollback playbook is pinned? I want the playbook link in the thread.

javier: yep pinned -> https://confluence.redwood/infer/rollbacks (step-by-step). Rollback window 15m after detection.

priya: quick QA note — we found a flaky integration test around auth refresh but it doesn't hit prod call path. I don't think it blocks.

amanda: tagging @ops-bot for DB migrations sanity check (no migrations in this release but double check connections).

ops-bot: DB pool size unchanged. No migrations. Healthchecks ready. :white_check_mark:

qa-bot: smoke tests passed against canary endpoint (sample size 200). Minor 1% higher tail on a specific route /v1/embed but within threshold.

deploy-bot: Canaries live at 5% in us-west. Initiating monitoring window. Stop/go call at +30m from rollout start.

amanda: calling stop/go now — any objections?

leo: vote: GO. Observability looks fine from infra side. :thumbsup:

javier: vote: HOLD — seeing a slight uptick in KV eviction on one host, investigating. Not critical yet but leaning hold until I confirm.

priya: vote: GO from product (release notes fix is tiny). If javier wants time to investigate, consider partial pin to us-west-a only?

amanda: @javier how long to confirm?

javier: give me 6m to check evictions and logs.

(6m pass)

javier: update: eviction spike was from a stress tester hitting a legacy endpoint, not the canary. Clearing HOLD.

amanda: consensus: GO. Proceed to 20% after warmup. Note: ops will keep an eye on p99 for next 45m.

deploy-bot: progressing ramp -> 20% scheduled in 10m. Will auto-abort if thresholds breached.

leo: also pushed a tiny release note correction commit: 9f2b3e (docs only). No functional change.

priya: leaving a reminder to update the RN page with the fix: placed a comment on the page.

amanda: final: pin decision for rollback triggers and set owner -> @javier to call rollback if thresholds hit. @amanda to coordinate comms.

deploy-bot: thread closed by ops policy, status=progressing, next-check-in=+30m.
